from forte2 import AVAS, CISolver, MCOptimizer, RHF, State, System

xyz = """
H 0.9126500000 0.0000000000 1.4575040000
H -0.9126500000 0.0000000000 1.4575040000
H 0.0000000000 -1.5856590000 -1.0386240000
H 0.0000000000 1.5856590000 -1.0386240000
C 0.0000000000 0.0000000000 0.8594920000
C 0.0000000000 -0.6512290000 -0.4995590000
C 0.0000000000 0.6512290000 -0.4995590000
"""

system = System(
    xyz=xyz,
    basis_set="cc-pvdz",
    auxiliary_basis_set="def2-universal-jkfit",
    minao_basis_set="cc-pvtz-minao",
)

rhf = RHF(charge=0)(system)

avas = AVAS(
    subspace=["C(2p)"],
    subspace_pi_planes=[["C1-3"]],
    selection_method="total",
    num_active=3,
    diagonalize=True,
)(rhf)

ci_solver = CISolver(State(nel=rhf.nel, multiplicity=1, ms=0.0))
mc = MCOptimizer(ci_solver)(avas)
mc.run()
